title: IoT device fleet console — Sparrowgrid Fleet
notes: v2 is a SvelteKit rewrite (scoped svelte-* classes). The device list becomes a <device-grid> web component whose cards are <device-card> web components, i.e. nested declarative shadow roots; cards are re-sorted with devices that need attention first, 'Update firmware' becomes 'Update to 2.4.0' and every reboot button shares the aria-label 'Reboot device'. Another sensor (SM-C11) also reports 18% battery. The summary chips become filter buttons in a new order with the label as bare text. The rollout panel moves before the map (now a <fleet-map> shadow root), swaps its action order and a confirmation <dialog> repeats 'Pause rollout'. The site select is relabelled 'Location'.
